question: Compare how many support tickets APAC and EMEA customers opened in 2025. If APAC opened more than 1.5 times as many as EMEA, break APAC's 2025 tickets down by month (label months as YYYY-MM); otherwise, break both regions' 2025 tickets down by severity.

sql_attempts.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND r.region_name IN ('APAC', 'EMEA') GROUP BY r.region_name), apac_count AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ticket_count FROM region_counts WHERE region_name = 'APAC'), 0) AS cnt), emea_count AS (SELECT COALESCE((SELECT ticket_count FROM region_counts WHERE region_name = 'EMEA'), 0) AS cnt) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) > 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) THEN STRFTIME('%Y-%m', t.created_date) ELSE r.region_name END AS breakdown_key, CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) > 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) THEN 'APAC Month' ELSE 'Region Severity' END AS grouping_type, CASE WHEN (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) <= 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) THEN t.severity ELSE NULL END AS severity, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS ticket_count FROM support_tickets AS t JOIN customers AS c ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' AND ((SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) > 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) AND r.region_name = 'APAC' OR (SELECT cnt FROM apac_count) <= 1.5 * (SELECT cnt FROM emea_count) AND r.region_name IN ('APAC', 'EMEA')) GROUP BY breakdown_key, severity ORDER BY breakdown_key, severity LIMIT 500
